description: Utility functions for throughput data processing, including data rate formatting, data rate calculation, timestamp formatting, chart data preparation, and unit conversions.

methods.name: formatDataRate
methods.description: Converts bytes per second to a human-readable data rate with appropriate units.

methods.name: calculateDataRate
methods.description: Calculates current data rate from cumulative byte counts, handling counter resets.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into HH:MM:SS string.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Prepares chart data series from time series throughput data, limiting to maxPoints.

methods.name: determineYAxisUnit
methods.description: Determines the appropriate unit (bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps) for the y-axis based on data rates.

methods.name: convertToUnit
methods.description: Converts data rate from bytes per second to a specified unit.
